# Sibubuh Playground

> Personal portfolio and blog of Sibubuh, an Indonesian web developer and content creator based in Sukabumi, West Java. The site collects digital work across web development, mobile apps, UI/UX design and KOL/influencer collaborations, alongside stories from the bubuh.id blog.

Sibubuh Playground is a personal site, not an agency. Project work, client logos, social presence and blog writing live in one place. Portfolio content is managed in Strapi; blog posts are published on Blogger at bubuh.id and pulled into the site through the Blogger feed.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://porto.bubuh.id/): Introduction, featured projects, recent blog posts, clients and social profiles.
- [Projects](https://porto.bubuh.id/projects): Full portfolio index. Each project lists its category, year, cover image and description.

## Project categories

Projects are grouped under these categories:

- Branding
- Key Opinion Leader (KOL)
- Web Development
- Social Media Manager
- Public Speaking
- Educator

## Blog

- [bubuh.id](https://www.bubuh.id): The owner's blog, covering photography, tourism, travel and lifestyle in Sukabumi. Recent posts are surfaced on the Sibubuh Playground homepage; the full archive lives on bubuh.id.
